name: chips-input
title: Chips Input
description: Tag input that turns typed text into chips, with keyboard editing, limits and optional suggestions.
improvements: Controlled or uncontrolled value (strings or { tag, image }), with onAdd/onDelete and a name for form submission.
Full keyboard model: Enter or comma adds, Backspace or Left Arrow moves to the chips, arrows and Home/End move between them (roving tabindex), Delete/Backspace removes.
Additions and removals are announced; chips have accessible remove buttons.
Suggestions reuse the accessible Autocomplete combobox, portalled so they are never clipped.
No image src injection: chip images are plain props with unsafe schemes dropped.
